answer: In PoA, each identity escrows collateral and signs messages under a bonded key. If k identities coordinate equivocation, the protocol aggregates correlated evidence and applies a quadratic penalty, O(k^2), to their slashing exposure rather than treating incidents independently. Detection also triggers an exponential capital-loss multiplier, causing a spiral of depleted bonds; delta-based accounting prevents recovery through redelegation, while summit-level coordination remains economically irrational.
